articles.t: GTA 6 Is Even Better When You Play It Side-By-Side With Your Wife
articles.chapeau: It might be the best way to play the game
articles.txt:
Needless to say, there are lots of people out there currently playing Grand Theft Auto 6, and despite what a lot of headlines and social media jokes insist, it’s not solely a boys’ club. Perhaps more than any other GTA game before it, the latest title attracts all kinds of people, and some of these people happen to be couples living in the same house—mirroring GTA 6’s protagonists just a little bit.
My partner, who has not played a Grand Theft Auto game before , and I have both been excited to lay our hands on GTA 6 , and stayed up late last night for the midnight unlock time. But unlike most in our situation, we neither passed the controller back and forth nor went to different rooms to enjoy our games separately. See, because I am an insane person, I have a setup that lets us both start the game simultaneously.
Obviously, both my partner and I are game journalists, and both of us have worked in this industry for many years. When we first started living together, after she moved to San Francisco to join IGN , I foresaw a situation in which we would both have to review games at the same time. Maybe, then, it would make sense for us to have setups that allowed us to play different consoles simultaneously, maybe in different rooms or parts of the same room.
“Why not just put them next to each other?” she posited as we mentally planned out our apartment. Why not, indeed!
That birthed what visiting friends all point out is a truly odd setup, but one that occasionally pays dividends. In the setup, we have my TV on the left and her TV on the right. The consoles on the left side are mine and only hook into my TV, while the consoles on the right side do the same to her TV, with the PC in the middle duplicating the image to both. Usually one person will wear headphones if we’re both playing something.
This works out well with a lot of games. When we were playing through Elden Ring before release side-by-side, one of us would occasionally look at the other’s screen, not recognize where the other person was, and so we’d share notes on how to get there. When Tears of the Kingdom launched at midnight, an informal race to get all the shrines motivated us to solve puzzles in more interesting ways than the other person.
With Grand Theft Auto 6 , though, it allowed us to see exactly what little details were changing in the game depending on our different actions and approaches.
In the game’s prologue , Lucia tries her best to make it back to a coffee shop while the police search for her, scouring the city block. Since it’s mere minutes after the opening of the game, my partner and I got there at roughly the same time. She, pragmatic as she is, chose to walk along the sidewalks until the cops eventually picked her up. I tried to cut around the building and swim, and then I got hit in the head by a police boat and was knocked unconscious. Whoops.
For me, in the cutscene that followed, Lucia was being handcuffed to a gurney while EMS and police pushed her into the back of an ambulance. For my partner, Lucia was being manhandled by police into the back of a cop car. In both situations, she pleaded about needing to go back to the coffee shop, but it was maybe a bit more fraught and scary in my case as she fought to maintain consciousness.
The scenes were similar, but different, and it was fascinating to be able to watch them side-by-side like this. That wow factor has kind of kept up throughout as we’ve continued playing. In an early mission, I watched her, playing as Jason, enter a car impound lot in a completely different way than I had. She gave me tips about when I would be able to play as Lucia, noticing that I was bumming around a lot (to which I answered, “But I have to make sure she’s happy with the house first.”)
I wonder if I’m signing up for a lifetime of doing more chores without realizing it.
We’re planning to play the bulk of the rest of the game like this; it probably won’t surprise anyone that we have a lot of TVs around the house and sometimes I move consoles around to play things in my office. But our setup is interesting, and it lets us spend time together while still partaking in hobbies that we love. Tonight we’re both going to continue playing GTA while I set up a laptop on the coffee table to watch the episode of AEW Dynamite that we missed yesterday, and that might be pushing it a little bit. Or maybe three screens is the perfect number?

articles.t: Parents: please don’t buy Grand Theft Auto VI for your child
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games’ brilliant 18-rated criminal caper is the most explicit game I’ve ever played, stuffed with sex, drugs and violence. It really is not for kids
articles.txt:
Not for nine-year-olds … Grand Theft Auto VI. Photograph: Rockstar View image in fullscreen Not for nine-year-olds … Grand Theft Auto VI. Photograph: Rockstar Parents: please don’t buy Grand Theft Auto VI for your child Keza MacDonald Rockstar Games’ brilliant 18-rated criminal caper is stuffed with sex, drugs and violence. It is the most explicit game I’ve ever played – and it really is not for kids
I am haunted still by an interaction I had at my stepson’s ninth birthday party in 2014, where one of the kids asked if I could put on Grand Theft Auto V for them all. “I have it at home!”, he said, giving me the puppy-dog eyes. Mentally replaying that game in my head, flashing back to the many scenes involving such things as smoking meth, over-the-top gratuitous violence and grubby sex in one character’s trailer, I said “ no way” . Later I gently mentioned to the kid’s mother that GTA V was an 18-rated game and really wasn’t suitable for kids. “Oh, but he’s really good at these games,” she told me. She was genuinely shocked to learn that an 18-rating on a video game was a flag for adult content, rather than an indication of its difficulty.
Grand Theft Auto VI is released this week. It is an incredible creative and technical feat, conjuring a realistic-looking and exhaustively detailed virtual Florida filled with every kind of filth and criminality you could imagine. It is brilliant, entertainingly observed and even sometimes unexpectedly touching, largely thanks to a central love story between the player couple , Jason and Lucia. It is lewd, violent and frequently hilarious. It is also absolutely full of stuff that I really would not want my 10 and seven-year-old boys to see or hear. I have never played a game that has more thoroughly earned its 18 rating.
Everyone knows that Grand Theft Auto is a violent game. It’s about crime and criminals, and VI’s story is about two fugitives in Vice City and the absolute dirtbags they meet along the way. You steal cars, run drugs, shoot cops and rival criminals and hold up gas stations; you kill hundreds of people over the course of the game. There are executions, brutal police raids and depictions of torture. None of that is particularly new, but it’s still pretty hardcore for, say, a nine-year-old. Plenty of millennials played Grand Theft Auto when we were underage, but video games are an awful lot more realistic now than they were 20 years ago; graphic violence on a PlayStation 2 from the 00s looks very different from graphic violence on a PlayStation 5 in 2026.
View image in fullscreen Adult if not grownup … Grand Theft Auto VI. Photograph: Rockstar Let’s leave the violence aside for a minute, though: there is also a lot more explicit sexual content in GTA VI than any previous GTA game, or any other video game period. 2004’s Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas was briefly pulled from sale because it contained a sex minigame that you couldn’t even access without hacking the game’s code. GTA VI, meanwhile, contains a LOT of sex that is in no way hidden, including between the two main characters. On another character’s laptop, there in a browsable in-game version of OnlyFans that pulls exactly no punches. There is full-frontal nudity, male and female. One mission takes place during a porn shoot, several others in strip clubs and bars, one in a hotel where you can burst into the wrong room to find an ongoing orgy or a bunch of people eating sushi off a naked body. I don’t personally fancy explaining any of this to my kids!
Then there’s the drugs. You run drugs, you steal drugs, you sell drugs and you take drugs. Pretty much everyone in Vice City really enjoys their coke; there are copious party scenes where powder is everywhere, and the player characters can partake if you want. Chapter 3 of the game is literally titled “Tits Ass Drug Money”. You might read all of this and think, my teenager has seen worse. That’s perfectly fair – but this is not stuff a 10- or 12-year-old can really contextualise, in my opinion (and the opinion of the ratings boards). If you think your child is too young to watch Breaking Bad, they are definitely too young for Grand Theft Auto VI .
Read more Even the in-game TV and radio is full of vulgar humour. On a phone-in show, I heard a caller and the host vamp extensively about her boyfriend’s penis’s resemblance, in size and smell, to a chicken nugget. articles.t: GTA 6 songs you
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6 players carry out missions to songs by artists such as Cardi B, Lana Del Rey and Travis Scott.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 relies on a murderer's row of musical hitmakers to provide the backbeat for cruising around Vice City.
The latest installment in the video game franchise, which officially launched on Thursday , features 34 original songs from a range of artists, including Cardi B, Lana Del Rey, Travis Scott and Morgan Wallen. The game's official album was created in partnership with Atlantic Records, and will be available on music platforms such as Spotify and Apple Music beginning on Nov. 20.
Rockstar Games, the company behind the GTA series, is also offering fans limited-edition vinyl and CDs featuring the original tracks.
Music is an essential part of the GTA experience for players like 34-year-old Kansas City resident Cameron Logan Cox, who credits the game's music over the years with helping springboard his career.
"I went on to become a filmmaker and director for a hip-hop label," he told CBS News. "I really don't think I would have had that musical affinity if not for GTA."
In addition to the official GTA 6 soundtrack, gamers will be exposed to countless other tracks through "in-game radio," a feature in GTA 6 that allows players to listen to songs from fictional radio stations while they carry out their missions. They can turn on a station while they drive through Vice City, or via their phone.
"My favorite thing in GTA has never been a mission," Cox told CBS News. "It's the car, the radio and nowhere I have to be."
GTA 6 offers 22 stations , according to industry media outlet GameStop. Some have DJ personas, such as the Cocoteo FM station, which is hosted by characters voiced by Puerto Rican singers Bad Bunny and RaiNao, according to Rolling Stone.
GameStop has a list of some of the songs in Vice City. Among the hundreds of tracks are old hits like "Let Your Love Flow" by the Bellamy Brothers and "Pour Some Sugar on Me" by Def Leppard, as well as more recent hits like Chappell Roan's "HOT TO GO!".

articles.t: GTA 6 reste à 30 FPS sur PS5 Pro : Rockstar explique pourquoi - GinjFo
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 vise 30 FPS même sur PS5 Pro. Rockstar explique pourquoi tout en indiquant les améliorations graphiques réservées à la console.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 est disponible sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S avec un objectif de 30 images par seconde, y compris sur la PS5 Pro. Il n’y a aucun mode Performance permettant de privilégier la fluidité. Rockstar explique pourquoi
Marc Chambers, directeur de la production technologique chez Rockstar, explique que le CPU légèrement amélioré de la PS5 Pro n’a pas la puissance nécessaire pour exécuter la simulation du jeu à une fréquence supérieure que celle des 30 fps.
Le titre est gourmand et ses besoins sont nombreux. Il doit par exemple calculer les déplacements, les comportements et les interactions d’un environnement particulièrement dense, en plus de produire l’image.
Avec un framerate de 30 images de secondes, nous avons un temps d’environ 33,3 millisecondes pour fabriquer l’image, contre 16,7 millisecondes à 60 images par seconde. Ces chiffres montrent que doubler la fluidité impose de terminer le travail deux fois plus vite. Si baisser la définition peut soulager le GPU dans la fabrication des images cela ne réduit pas les calculs nécessaires pour animer la circulation ou les personnages.
Rockstar indique que l’ensemble de ses systèmes entre tout juste dans ce budget d’environ 33 millisecondes. Le studio explique également que la répartition des tâches entre CPU et GPU ne permet pas de proposer simplement un compromis à 40 FPS.
La puissance graphique supplémentaire de la PS5 sert surtout à enrichir la présentation. Aux reflets et à l’éclairage global en Ray tracing s’ajoutent des ombres en Ray tracing et une meilleure netteté grâce au PSSR, la technologie de reconstruction d’image de Sony.
Du coup si vous envisagez une PS5 Pro principalement pour GTA 6, le bénéfice porte sur la qualité visuelle, sans mode à 60 FPS.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' release live updates: Reviews, memes and more as gamers explore and react to Leonida after 13 long years
articles.chapeau: After a long wait, the sequel to 'GTA 5' is out and people are stoked.
articles.txt:
A gamer plays Grand Theft Auto VI at a café in New Delhi on Nov. 19. (Bhawika Chhabra/Reuters) Grand Theft Auto VI is here at last and gamers around the world can finally play after it launched at midnight globally. So far the game, which takes up a whopping 212GB on your PlayStation5 or Xbox , is receiving rave reviews . GTA 6 is streaming all over Twitch and the memes, clips and hot takes have been pouring in.
Digital marketing firm Sensor Tower estimates that GTA 6 pre-orders have already topped $1.65 billion in sales. GTA 6 costs $79.99 for PS5 and Xbox , with an "ultimate" version priced at $99.99.
Players began pre-loading GTA 6 last week, even though they probably had to clear some space on their consoles. Millions of people are expected to take time off work and school to play GTA 6 . Xbox has a doctor's note from DJ Khaled (aka Dr. Xbox) that may be the excuse you need (but you'll probably want to clear it with your boss either way).
PlayStation's network suffered a brief outage Wednesday afternoon as the game became available and players made the required update to their consoles. But since Wednesday evening, it's been smooth sailing.
Actress and comedian Janelle James, who stars as principal Ava Coleman on the TV show Abbott Elementary , says she's a long-time Grand Theft Auto fan, so much so that she "bullied" Rockstar Games into appearing in GTA 6.
James said in an Instagram highlight posted to her page Thursday that she not only voiced her talk radio show character in the game, but she also "pursued, conceptualized, pitched, scripted AND voice acted" the show. In addition, she cast her friends Zainab Johnson and Glitter Cheese as guests on the show.
"I've been playing this game since Vice City (was previously overcommitted to Metal Gear) and this is a literal dream come true," James wrote. "Hope to catch y'all in these online streets where I will promptly kick you square in your back then put 2 in your dome. (PS5) Cheers!!!""

articles.t: GTA 6 excitement has some Alabama gamers taking time off work
articles.chapeau: Some Alabama gamers are already planning to take time off work to play Grand Theft Auto 6, as a new study estimates the release could cost the state millions in lost wages.
articles.txt:
BIRMINGHAM, Ala. ( WBRC ) - After more than a decade of waiting, fans of the Grand Theft Auto franchise are getting ready for the latest installment, and some are already making plans to play it.
Grand Theft Auto 6 takes players to Leonida , a fictional state inspired by Florida. The game features Vice City and follows two main characters, Jason and Lucia, as they become caught up in a criminal conspiracy.
“I’ve been waiting for this game for, what, 15 years? 14 years. So I’m excited just to play it. Every mission in the game, you just see the graphics, everything,” gamer Pedro Maldonado said.
Players can explore the city, drive through its streets, and follow the characters’ story in an open-world experience.
For some gamers, the excitement is so big that they’re already planning to take time off work.
“Yeah, bro. I already took off two days of PTO just to play this thing,” gamer Jaden Steagull said.
Rudy Fernandez said some of his friends are also using paid time off to make sure they don’t miss the release.
“Yeah, we’ve already talked about it. I’ve got friends taking off, taking PTO to make sure that they’re getting their money well spent from the game. I think I may be out of PTO days, so I may have to wait till the weekend,” Fernandez said.
A study by Amazon Slots estimates nearly 14,000 Alabamians could miss work for GTA 6, costing the state about $3.5 million in lost wages. Nationwide, the estimated losses could exceed $301 million.
The game is also expected to generate billions of dollars. Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 generated $1.84 billion in first-day revenue, with 19.1 million copies sold.
“Oh, man, I don’t care about the price right now. I think the game is worth the money,” Maldonado said.

articles.t: CyberLeek Claims to Have Released 209GB GTA 6 Build, but Executable Is Missing - SSBCrack News
articles.chapeau: CyberLeek, the online persona of a group previously linked to leaks of Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay, claims it has begun distributing a 209GB development build
articles.txt:
CyberLeek, the online persona of a group previously linked to leaks of Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay, claims it has begun distributing a 209GB development build of the game. The group says the files represent a November 2026 build, potentially close to—or identical to—the version intended for release.
The claim could not be independently verified. Although the download’s advertised size was visible on CyberLeek’s site, the existence of the files themselves has not been confirmed. The build also appears to be missing its main executable, which would be needed to run the game. CyberLeek says it is withholding that file and may publish it later.
In a statement posted on its site, the group said it had the “full November 2026 build” and that it was being distributed by torrent, with the executable held “on a countdown.” CyberLeek says it will release that file ahead of schedule if its cryptocurrency token reaches a set value. The group’s previous leaks have also been associated with a crypto scheme, which was earlier estimated to have generated at least £200,000 for those behind it.
CyberLeek first threatened to release a complete, playable build in October. Its latest claims raise the possibility that the game could be made to run on PC before Rockstar announces an official PC version. However, that outcome remains uncertain: the build has not been verified, and the missing executable currently prevents it from being launched. Rumours have suggested a PC release could follow the console launch by several months, but Rockstar has not announced a PC release.
The group says it expects the Xbox build to be made to work and claims a community could have it running through emulation within a week. It also said it would seek a PlayStation 5 build as a fallback if the Xbox version proves unusable. These claims have not been independently confirmed.
CyberLeek has previously framed its actions as a campaign for “Gamers’ Rights,” citing opposition to the industry’s move toward digital-only games and the discontinuation of physical discs. Rockstar has described the earlier leaks as “heartbreaking,” saying they were not how the company intended players to see the game. Take-Two Interactive has also sought information about the leaker’s identity through a subpoena to Discord.

articles.t: GTA 6 Fans Theorize that Mandy Has a Dark, Violent Secret
articles.chapeau: A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral since the game's launch for being a total smokeshow, but she also seems to have a dark secret.
articles.txt:
A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral for being a total smokeshow, but fans are also noticing that she seems to have a dark secret.
Early on in the game, Brian sends Jason to go retrieve rent from a tenant named Mandy, who refuses to pay until her sink is fixed. Once you get there, it's clear she has staged a maintenance emergency so Jason would turn up. She's madly obsessed with him, but Jason pays no mind, since he's still pursuing Lucia. She eventually tries to seduce Jason with a skimpy bikini, to no avail. He ends up pulling out whatever is lodged in her sink, which she quickly takes and runs off with.
Mandy eventually gets irritated with Jason's disinterest and kicks him out, but if players linger around the property, they may start to realize Mandy isn't just obsessive because she has a crush... but because she may be a killer. If you wander into her backyard, you will see a freshly covered-up, body-sized hole next to a few tubs of acid. But hey, maybe it's just a coincidence! If you pop the trunk of her car, you will also see more acid and tools someone might use to kidnap and kill a person. And if you take a quick look at what was in Mandy's sink, it appears to be a severed finger.
While it's unclear if she's actually a serial killer (it takes three victims to be classified as one, by the way), she does appear to have killed at least one person. It's unclear who the other guy is, but it's possible Jason could've met a similar fate. Does she seduce people in order to kill them? Or does she kill them because they reject her advances or hurt her emotionally? It's hard to say. Either way, it seems clear that there's definitely a screw loose, and it's good that Jason didn't fall for her seduction.

articles.t: GTA 6 has the best use of the PS5 controller I
articles.chapeau: The PS5 triggers are changing how I drive in GTA.
articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Six years into owning my PS5, I can count on one hand how many times the DualSense controller's resistive triggers have proved essential to the game I'm playing. They're key for Astro Bot's varied trigger-based mechanics, of course, and I wouldn't want to play Death Stranding 2 without my heavy backpack fighting back against me.
GTA 6 uses the whole DualSense buffalo for a variety of sensory additives—I can feel it in the haptics when I roll over the rumble strip on the shoulders of roads or rear end another car—but the way it uses the triggers is especially effective. The resistive triggers activate when you'd expect, like while shooting guns, but they also come into play in activities that feel like they were designed around the controller: When swinging dumbbells, for instance, the triggers help me time when to release and start another rep. It's cool stuff.
Rockstar's smartest use of the triggers, and one of my favorite new features of GTA 6 in general, is its two-stage throttle for vehicles : When you pull the throttle (right trigger) in any car, there's a hard resistive stop at about the 50% to 60% point.
I've been calling this low-speed mode . At this speed, my car moves at a cruising pace that I find very comfortable—still slightly faster than NPC cars, but slow enough to follow the flow of traffic, take in my surroundings, or easily slam the brakes before running over a grandma on her way home from Canasta. I've also been calling it "normal driving" mode.
Don't worry, it's not hard to fully gun it either: Just pull the trigger with a little gusto and you're off to the races. This is what the two speeds look like:
This has completely changed how I drive in GTA. I'm already someone who takes these games slowly, but the natural stopping point of the throttle makes this easy and natural—as if Rockstar is not just allowing for a more immersive playstyle, but endorsing it.
Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.
It's just a different experience than having to manually learn the speed thresholds and intuitively hold the trigger at an exact middle point. This is more like I'm pulling the trigger to one natural stop for "slow", and another for "fast". It's the four-wheeled equivalent of Jason and Lucia's walk (you have to press L3 to enter a jog or sprint), or the default saunter of Red Dead Redemption 2's horses.
I can only recall one other open world game with a similar feature: the older Mafia games had speed limit toggles that automatically prevented cars from surpassing the speed limit. I always liked that, too, but this is more elegant.
It turns out Rockstar's co-branding campaign that insists GTA 6 "plays best on PS5" isn't just marketing. In these months before GTA 6 is a PC game , I really would suggest you play it on a PlayStation for the controller perks alone. And when the time comes, I hope Rockstar goes the extra mile to port these DualSense features to the PC version.

An unreleased D’Angelo song has surfaced in Grand Theft Auto VI . Players have reported hearing a track titled “Kamikazi” while tuned to the in-game radio station Worldwide FM. The song does not appear on any of D’Angelo’s three studio albums, and no standalone release has been announced.
“Kamikazi” plays on Worldwide FM alongside tracks by the likes of Jamiroquai and Roberta Flack . It isn’t D’Angelo’s only appearance on the dial, either: “Lady,” from his 1995 debut Brown Sugar , can be heard over on the R&B-focused Honey FM.

Dans Grand Theft Auto VI, l’argent occupe une place bien plus importante que dans les précédents épisodes. Entre les voitures, les armes, les vêtements et les nombreux achats possibles, Jason et Lucia auront rapidement besoin de remplir leur compte en banque. Heureusement, Rockstar propose de nombreuses activités criminelles permettant de faire fortune dans Leonida. Voici les meilleures méthodes pour gagner rapidement de l’argent dans GTA 6.
Il existe de nombreuses façons de gagner de l’argent dans GTA VI , mais toutes ne sont pas aussi rentables. Certaines activités permettent de récolter quelques milliers de dollars sans prendre trop de risques, tandis que les plus gros braquages peuvent rapporter des sommes considérables. Bien entendu, les activités et les opportunités se multiplient à mesure que vous progressez dans le scénario ( comme ici en début de jeu ). Voici les meilleures méthodes pour gagner rapidement de l’argent dans GTA 6 .
Voler et revendre des voitures à Moses dans GTA 6 GTA 6 – revendre voiture // Source : ActuGaming
L’une des premières méthodes intéressantes consiste à voler des véhicules pour les revendre. Après avoir rencontré Moses au chapitre 2, vous pourrez lui livrer certaines voitures dérobées dans les rues de Leonida. À ce stade, privilégiez les véhicules qui ne possèdent pas de traceur, car Moses n’accepte pas encore tous les modèles. Une voiture peut généralement rapporter un peu plus de 1 000 $, ce qui reste intéressant pour une opération qui ne demande que quelques minutes.
Il faut toutefois patienter un court moment entre deux ventes. Nous vous conseillons donc d’alterner cette activité avec des missions secondaires ou de l’exploration pour éviter de perdre du temps. À partir du chapitre 3, de nouvelles possibilités de revente se débloquent, notamment pour les véhicules équipés de traceurs.
Les repaires de gangs constituent une autre excellente solution pour gagner rapidement de l’argent. Ces lieux renferment généralement des marchandises illégales, des objets de valeur et parfois de l’argent liquide. L’avantage est que vous pouvez récupérer un butin intéressant sans devoir préparer un braquage particulièrement complexe. En revanche, il faudra souvent éliminer ou neutraliser plusieurs criminels avant de pouvoir fouiller les lieux.
Pensez à examiner soigneusement les bâtiments et à récupérer les sacs de marchandises. La drogue, les bijoux et les billets marqués pourront ensuite être revendus auprès des receleurs.
Durant votre exploration, vous serez régulièrement témoin d’événements imprévus qui peuvent se transformer en excellentes occasions de récupérer du butin. Il est notamment possible de profiter d’un braquage commis par d’autres criminels pour leur voler leur marchandise.
Vous pouvez également tomber sur des transactions entre trafiquants, notamment sur certaines pistes d’aéroport. Autant d’opportunités qui permettent de récupérer de l’argent ou des marchandises sans avoir à organiser vous-même une opération criminelle.
Fouiller le monde ouvert peut également rapporter gros si vous y consacrez un peu de temps. Au-delà des événements aléatoires et des rencontres particulières, le simple fait d’explorer les différents environnements de Leonida constitue une excellente méthode pour accumuler de l’argent.
On atteint ainsi assez rapidement la limite des 20 000 $ en espèces que chaque protagoniste peut transporter. Vous trouverez notamment de nombreux billets dans des coffrets et des caches dissimulées un peu partout, mais aussi des marchandises illégales en fouillant certaines habitations ou de petites plantations de cannabis.
N’hésitez donc pas à vous éloigner des grands axes et à examiner les bâtiments que vous croisez. Certaines découvertes peuvent se révéler particulièrement lucratives.
En parlant justement de la limite des 20 000 $ en liquide pour Jason et Lucia, sachez que cet argent peut être partiellement ou entièrement perdu si vous mourez ou que vous êtes arrêté par la police. articles.t: Everything You Missed on GTA 6 Launch Day (And the Tips Worth Knowing First)
Rockstar co-lead explains how Red Dead Redemption 2 fixed GTA 6's prologue
articles.chapeau: You spoke, Rockstar listened 🙏
articles.txt:
GTA 6's opening purposefully avoids Red Dead Redemption 2's biggest mistake.
The GTA VI prologue is a masterclass in storytelling. It sets the tone of the game immediately while still having that authentic Grand Theft Auto charm.
My introduction to Jason and Lucia took me by surprise in what could very well be one of the best kept secrets in gaming. No spoilers, of course, but I’m so surprised it didn’t leak ahead of launch.
In the run up to GTA VI’s historic launch, I spoke to GTA VI’s h ead of development and Rockstar Games co-head Rob Nelson to learn more about the game’s prologue, and what lessons were learned from Red Dead Redemption 2.
For those who may have forgotten. Rockstar’s previous game has one of the most agonisingly slow openings to any AAA game ever made, so much so that the majority of players would probably skip it entirety if they could.
During my entire time reviewing GTA VI , I was probably at my most-critical during the prologue and first chapter – and that’s largely because of Red Dead Redemption 2 ’s opening crawl.
While playing for the first time, I kept asking myself this question: “When I inevitably replay this game, will I be okay with doing all of this again?”
Fortunately, Rockstar Games has put considerable effort into speeding up the opening and getting you into the open-world quicker, and fan feedback to Red Dead Redemption 2 had a hand in this.
Rob Nelson told me: “When we were doing Red Dead we had committed to that winter section pretty early on, and we were kind of stuck with it. It was designed to teach you how to play the game, because the game was more complicated than anything that we had done before.”
Even on your first playthrough, Red Dead Redemption 2’s opening feels like a slow-burn, so you’ll probably be surprised to hear it was meant to be even longer .
“We took as much fat out of it as we could if you can believe that. There's a lot of cuts where we skipped the journey, because it was originally longer … We made it as fast as we could.”
Rockstar applied a similar logic to GTA VI , but took the trimming even further to ensure players could dive into Leonida as quickly as possible.
“In Chapter 1, we were very aware of the length. We really didn't want to bog players down with awkward tutorial stuff, so we tried to make it all feel as seamless as possible, and also trust players more," Rob said.
“Your first objective in the prologue is to lose the cops so we teach you how to jump and teach you how to run. That's pretty much it."
Nelson explained this was done to “get you to Jason in the open world as expediently as possible” for those who want to start exploring straight away.
Yet despite quickening the pace compared to Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA VI’s opening doesn’t feel any less impactful.
Somehow, Rockstar appealed to both crowds: the players who want to immerse themselves in a rich narrative and those who just want to drive off and cause some trouble.
GTA VI is without a doubt Rockstar Games’ best work to date, and we’re so glad it’s finally here. It was worth the wait.

articles.t: Fernando Mendoza gets cheeky GTA 6 nod from protagonist Lucia

articles.txt:
Fans have been waiting years for the latest installment of the legendary GTA franchise, which finally released with GTA 6 on Thursday .
Grand Theft Auto 6’s primary setting is Vice City, which is Rockstar Games’ modern-day take on Miami.
But it was Las Vegas Raiders starting quarterback Fernando Mendoza who is getting love from the video game.
Many who started playing GTA 6 on Thursday noticed an early scene in the game where the two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, were sitting on the couch eating ice cream together.
Lucia was wearing a black and silver football jersey with No. 15 on the front.
Rockstar largely avoids real-world brand licenses in Grand Theft Auto games so that they don’t have to pay for the rights. But almost everything in the game is a parody of a real-life brand.
This would seem to be the case with this jersey, as it doesn’t officially have a Raiders logo. But the black and silver, combined with Mendoza’s No. 15, makes it clear who this jersey is supposed to represent.
Not to mention that Mendoza is from Miami, Florida , which makes this in-game connection make perfect sense.

articles.t: Michigan gamers explain why they're taking time off work for GTA 6
articles.chapeau: The highly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto VI was released on Thursday. Some Michigan gamers are celebrating by taking the day off work to play.
articles.txt:
Facebook Twitter LinkedIn Email Listen • 4:27 Rockstar Games The highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI released on Thursday. Some Michigan gamers are celebrating by taking the day off work to play. Fans of the Grand Theft Auto video games have been waiting for 10 years for a sequel to the critically acclaimed GTA V . Well, now their wait is over. Amid high expectations and high excitement from gamers, GTA VI was released on Thursday. And according to Jeff Grubb, veteran video-game journalist and host of the podcast Game Mess Mornings, the wait was worth it.
“So the surprising thing is that it didn't just like meet those expectations across the board,” Grubb said. “Everyone I've spoken to as I play the game through these first 10 hours or so, it does really feel like they went above and beyond.”
Grubb said that in a world where the tools to build games are becoming more democratized, big gaming studios have to deliver something special to capture the kind of attention they are getting with GTA VI .
“One way that games can stand out is to be more expensive, and to look more expensive, and to have more options than ever before.”
Estimates put the cost of game development at over $1 billion, though the developer Rockstar Games has not provided an exact figure. But that investment, Grubb, said, shows in the detailed game play and expansive world building.
To celebrate, many Michigan fans of the franchise are calling off work this week to sink their teeth into the immersive world and cutting-edge graphics.
“I was leading a stand-up meeting today at work, and I was telling them someone has to cover our monthly business review because I'm off Thursday and I'm taking it off for a video game,” said Wyoming resident Charlie Hunt. “And no, it's not negotiable.”
Courtesy / Charlie Hunt Charlie Hunt will intentionally be playing Grand Theft Auto VI while his kids are at school. Hunt is 43 years old and a project manager at Steelcase. He’s planning to take Thursday and Friday off so he can play the game while his kids are at school.
“I have 7-year-old kids, and I also have a full-time job. And sometimes video games and my kids work really well together. They'll watch me play Fortnite, I'll introduce them to Nintendo games, that sort of thing. But this is a game that's kind of incompatible with my role as a dad.”
GTA is a famously violent game. Players steal cars, evade police, and shoot bystanders with high-powered firearms. But for many of the gamers we spoke to, the violence of the game was not the main draw of GTA VI . It was the chance to escape their adult lives for a few hours — and reconnect with a past version of themselves.
Courtesy / Ryan Lee This week Ryan Lee bought a Playstation 5 to play Grand Theft Auto VI. “I think it kind of brings me back to when I was younger,” explained Ryan Lee from Saginaw. “So definitely kind of bringing me back to when I was, like, real young, a teenager, and, you know, kind of like that where you don't realize, when you're older, you have to pay bills, go to work every day.”
For gas station manager Patrick Dumond, the game also offers him a chance to find refuge from the difficult parts of his job.
"I work overnight in a gas station," he said. "So it's a good feeling to go home and be able to pop in a game. ... It allows me to escape from the trials and tribulations I deal with on a daily basis."
Lee is also planning to take the day off to immerse himself in the game — something he has never done before.
“I actually went on my lunch today to pick up a PlayStation 5,” he said. “I didn't even own one.”
The hype around the release of the latest installment has been intense. Originally scheduled to release in 2025, the drop date has been pushed back several times. The delay has only heightened the excitement for many fans.
“And the fact that this game has over $1 billion budget, no expense spared, no time spared. I mean, as we all know from the delays,” said Hunt. “I'm just really excited for a luxury experience and seeing what that looks like in 2026 and how I interpret it as a 43-year-old. I mean, I was just turning 30 when the last one came out.”
For fellow Wyoming resident Randy Thomas, the game’s release holds a deeper, more personal significance.

articles.t: Cyberleek releases GTA 6 Xbox build, making playable PC port more realistic
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek has made another comeback, leaking a November GTA 6 Xbox build. The download lacks the vital executable file, with its release timing depending on a new cryptocurrency goal. Hackers are studying the files for a potential Series X emulator or decompilation build on PCs.
articles.txt:
Just when it seemed Cyberleek had disappeared for good, the notorious leaker has returned. Even though the GTA 6 release date has passed, the individual has followed through on past threats. A decrypted Xbox build is spreading through piracy networks, which could lead to a playable PC port . However, there is one major caveat with the 209 GB download.
The Cyberleek website now displays a message about the latest leak. While prior gameplay videos appeared to be from a PC-based development build , they elected to distribute GTA 6 Xbox files. Allegedly, this version is from November 2026, and images of a file structure exposing assets have emerged. Regardless, it may have limited use without the missing executable file.
Once again, Cyberleek hopes to raise cryptocurrency funds before releasing the critical file. Offering a playable build as the reward, they previously set a $30 million market capitalization goal for a meme coin. That October initiative failed, but hitting the $15 million mark will supposedly unlock the .exe.
Notably, a timer is also counting down from under 4 days. Once it expires, Rockstar ’s tormentor promises to circulate the executable on piracy sites anyway.
It's unclear how soon the GTA 6 Xbox files may result in a bootable game for PC users. Cyberleek believes hackers will find a way to emulate the console version for Windows within a week. As criticism of the 30 fps performance target continues, capable hardware could produce higher frame rates.
Unfortunately for pirates, no working Series X emulator currently exists. The hardware found in the Microsoft console and many PCs is similar, with CPUs sharing x86-64 architecture. Still, among other challenges, the Series X runs a custom OS that would need to be adapted for a Windows environment.
Another possibility is a decompilation project targeting the leaked GTA 6 Xbox files. Developers would analyze, modify, and reconstruct the code into a version that can boot on PCs.
Cyberleek also claims to possess a PS5 build as a fallback option. Besides accumulating cryptocurrency, the objective is to prevent console and PC ports from doubling Take-Two and Rockstar's profits.

articles.t: GTA 6 Xbox build reportedly leaked by Cyberleek, but it's not playable, yet
GTA VI Leaker Releases 209 GB Xbox Build Without Main Executable
articles.chapeau: A GTA VI leaker has released a claimed 209 GB Xbox build without its executable, with the missing file tied to a countdown and cryptocurrency target.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek, the group behind earlier GTA VI leaks, has released what they claim is a complete November 2026 Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI, minus the main executable needed to run the game. The GTA VI Xbox build leak surfaced on November 19, the same day Rockstar Games’ latest open-world title launched on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
The torrent is approximately 209 GB and contains what appear to be the game’s data and pack folders, RPF archives, and Xbox-specific configuration files.
According to announcements published on Cyberleek’s website, the missing executable will be released once a countdown expires. The leaker is also offering to release it earlier if a cryptocurrency token named CYBERLEEK reaches a market capitalization of $15 million. That target was previously set at $30 million before being reduced.
Cyberleek has also discussed the possibility of pursuing a PlayStation 5 build if the leaked Xbox files cannot be made to work. The leaker claimed that the community could emulate the Xbox version within a week, although there is currently no evidence that such an effort will succeed.
The GTA VI Xbox build leak has attracted attention on Reddit’s r/Piracy community, where several users claim to have examined the files. One commenter said they discovered 145 mission records inside a common.rpf archive, including references to the game’s protagonists, Lucia and Jason.
Cyberleek previously attracted scrutiny from Take-Two Interactive after releasing gameplay footage, map information, and a 24-minute cutscene earlier this fall. Those earlier leaks were also connected to the same cryptocurrency token.
The authenticity of the newly released Xbox files remains unconfirmed, and the missing executable has not been made publicly available.

CL s’en fiche. Cette communauté l’aura émulée d’ici une semaine avec un framerate bien supérieur à 30 FPS. CL vous a dit de ne pas précommander pour une bonne raison. C’est l’une de ces raisons.

CyberLeek, the persona of a hacker group that was responsible for leaking GTA 6 gameplay before the game launched, has reappeared today, claiming to have released a development build of the final version of the game on its site. This new leak appears to be making good on a threat posted back in October, where the group stated its intent to release a full, playable build of the game .
Various social media accounts have visited the site and noted the size of the download offered by CyberLeek is, indeed 209GB. Eurogamer has seen the site and can confirm this is what the group has claimed, however I have been unable to verify the existence of any actual files. On the site, CyberLeek claims this build is from November 2026 - meaning it is very close to (if not the actual) release build. The 'executable file appears to be missing from the build, however, meaning you cannot actually - yet - get it up and running. CyberLeek is threatening to release this file at a later date, however.
"It is done," a statement from CyberLeek reads. "[Cyberleek] holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto 6, and it is going out by torrent. Now. Every file except one. The main executable is held on a countdown." CyberLeek says the executable will be released earlier than planned if its crypto token reaches a predetermined value. Many of the leaks to date have been related to a CyberLeek crypto scheme. Previously, it was estimated that the group cashed out at least £200,000.
What does all this mean? There's a very realistic chance that the game could be up and running on PC soon - undercutting Rockstar's unannounced PC release by a matter of months , if current rumours are to be believed. "This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps," the statement continues. "[CyberLeek] told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons.
"If the Xbox build cannot be made to work and support holds, [CyberLeek] will work to get a PS5 build - a fallback, most likely never required. Either way: the Xbox build is going out. No double dipping for Take-Two/Rockstar." It seems these are not empty threats.
CyberLeek has been a thorn in Rockstar's side for a while now. The group initially claimed it took this action in the name of "Gamers' Rights", supposedly fighting for consumers in relation to the controversial discontinuation of game-discs and the digital-only future being pursued by game publishers. Rockstar has previously issued statements regarding the leaker , noting that the leaks are "heartbreaking" and that "this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time". Take-Two tried to subpoena Discord for information pertaining to the leaker's identity.

articles.t: « Un pic de trafic jamais atteint » : comment la sortie de GTA 6 met les réseaux Internet français sous tension
articles.chapeau: Très attendu par les fans depuis treize ans, le jeu vidéo GTA 6 fait déjà exploser les records. Son téléchargement a représenté jusqu’à 40 %
articles.txt:
Plusieurs fournisseurs d’accès à Internet (FAI) français ont fait état jeudi de pics de trafic sur leur réseau en lien avec la sortie très attendue du jeu vidéo GTA 6 , jouable en France depuis minuit.
Particularité de cet opus : il n’existe qu’en version dématérialisée et doit donc obligatoirement être téléchargé pour pouvoir y jouer, la boîte vendue en magasin contenant un code pour le télécharger.
« Nous avons constaté cette nuit un pic de trafic jamais atteint sur notre réseau, avec une hausse de 10 % par rapport aux jours habituellement les plus chargés, le dimanche notamment », a indiqué dans une réponse écrite Jérôme Latrille, directeur technique et plan réseau chez Bouygues Telecom .
Vidéo GTA 6 : police pas nulle, Pokédex et couchers de soleil... tout ce qu’on a vu en 3 heures de jeu
Si l’entreprise n’a pas donné de chiffres précis sur le niveau du trafic, Jérôme Latrille a aussi indiqué qu’« en journée, le téléchargement du jeu a pu représenter jusqu’à 40 % du trafic total » de son réseau, « soit davantage que Netflix et YouTube réunis, qui sont habituellement nos deux plus gros consommateurs de trafic avec environ 20 % chacun ».
Du côté d’Orange , les téléchargements du jeu ont « notamment contribué à établir un nouveau record de trafic » le 12 novembre, lors de la mise à disposition du jeu dans les boutiques, puis de nouveau dans la soirée de mercredi, « avec un pic atteint à 22 heures ».
« Nous avons constaté un pic de trafic plus important que la semaine dernière mais cela n’a pas entraîné de difficultés notables », a de son côté indiqué Free. Enfin, SFR a aussi relevé « une pointe de trafic » mercredi, « sans impact » sur son réseau.
La sortie de ce nouvel opus de la saga Grand Theft Auto, attendue depuis treize ans par les fans et préparée à grand renfort de campagne publicitaire, est déjà celle de tous les records.
La maison mère de son développeur Rockstar, l’éditeur américain Take-Two Interactive, n’a pas encore communiqué de chiffres de ventes mais le cabinet Sensor Tower assure que les précommandes ont dépassé les 19 millions, générant plus de 1,8 milliard de dollars (1,64 milliard d’euros).
D’après le spécialiste de la veille sur les réseaux sociaux Visibrain, la sortie mondiale a généré plus de 2,6 millions de messages sur les réseaux sociaux en 24 heures, soit plus que le lancement de la Coupe du monde de football 2026.

articles.t: GTA 6 Leak: CyberLeek Claims 209 GB Xbox Build Is Out
articles.chapeau: CyberLeek claims to have shared a 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6 on launch day. The leaker says the missing executable will follow when a countdown ends.
articles.txt:
CyberLeek has returned, claiming to leak a 209GB GTA 6 Xbox build, but withheld the executable. They’re demanding crypto funding, so skepticism—and avoiding payment—is strongly advised.
On October 14, CyberLeek signed off with a three-part statement titled The End of the Road. “The leeks stop here. For now.” Turns out “for now” meant 36 days. It’s GTA 6 launch day and CyberLeek is back, claiming to have released a November Xbox build of the game via torrent. The download reportedly weighs in at 209 GB. The one file CyberLeek says they’ve kept to themselves is the executable you’d need to actually run the thing.
Aside from the executable, the download seems real and does seem to be the game files, at least according to people who have already jumped on and checked it all out. Obviously, I won’t be linking to the files here.
According to a statement attributed to CyberLeek and reproduced on Reddit, the executable will be released when a countdown hits zero. That countdown will end on November. There is, of course, a way to speed that up, because of course there is. If the leaker’s cryptocurrency reaches a $15 million market cap, they say they’ll release the file immediately. “30 million was too ambitious; half that seems fair,” reads the statement.
This seems utterly stupid. Why pay a bunch of money to this CyberLeek entity if they are already saying they’ll give you the missing file in 4 days anyway?
Back in October, CyberLeek promised to release the entire game if the coin hit that massive $30 million target. When the coin fell woefully short, the leaker said uploading more than 200 GB anonymously was too risky without the money to fund their “secret project”.
What’s changed is that there’s now a package people can inspect. If those 209 GB check out, which they seem to, then I’d be surprised if CyberLeek had somehow got hold of everything except the executable. Whether they’ll ever part with it is another question.
Which brings me to the choice of platform. The earlier footage was widely thought to show the game running on PC. If CyberLeek had a working PC build back then, what happened to that one? Why are we wow we’re being offered Xbox files with the executable held back? CyberLeek reckons somebody else will have the game emulated for PC inside a week, also begging the queston of why not release the PC build you seemingly already had? In the very same statement, they say they’ll try to get a PS5 build if the Xbox one doesn’t work and support holds.
Could somebody eventually get these files running on PC? I’m well outside my area of expertise on that one. The recompilation projects seen for older Xbox games typically start with the compiled game code or the source code , which is exactly why that missing executable matters. These files might give somebody a head start, but I’ve yet to see anyone demonstrate a PC version running from this download. Of course, it’s only been like five minutes, so it’s hardly a surprise nothing has popped up yet.
The bit I keep coming back to, though, is November. CyberLeek was already showing off 25 minutes of GTA 6 in early October, teasing that they already had a full build at that point. If “the full November 2026 build” means a newer version than the one in that footage, how did they get their hands on it this close to launch? Did they still have a source inside Rockstar feeding them newer builds? Or did they only get access to a complete copy recently, after spending October promising they could release one? Was the earlier footage actually from a much smaller version of the game?
There’s a simpler possibility, too. With GTA 6 now on sale, these could be files from the retail Xbox release. A build number we could put alongside the retail one would tell us a hell of a lot more about where those 209 GB came from.
The other piece of timing is also interesting: the game is out now. CyberLeek waited to return and actually release files until the game launched. That doesn’t inspire confidence in some of his earlier build claims.
His target now is realistically PC gamers since they are being forced to sit and watch their console brethren enjoy the game, with zero announced launch date for the PC build. Again, though, questions must be asked: if PC gamers are the ones most eager to actually get the game, why release an Xbox build? Was it always an Xbox build? Hmm.
There’s too much strangness. None of this makes real sense, to me.

articles.t: GTA 6 : un hacker affirme avoir mis en ligne une build de développement, la communauté sceptique
articles.txt:
Un individu se présentant sous le pseudonyme de Cyberleek a récemment fait surface en affirmant avoir mis en ligne une build de développement de Grand Theft Auto VI . Cette annonce, qui a immédiatement enflammé les réseaux sociaux et les forums spécialisés, est accueillie avec un très haut degré de scepticisme par la communauté. En effet, le nom de Cyberleek est associé à de précédentes tentatives de fuites, souvent jugées peu crédibles, et aucune preuve tangible n’a pour l’instant été apportée pour étayer ces nouvelles déclarations.
Selon les informations relayées par Video Games Chronicle , Cyberleek n’avait plus fait parler de lui depuis la sortie officielle de GTA 6 . Son retour soudain avec une annonce aussi fracassante a de quoi surprendre, d’autant que le jeu est désormais disponible depuis plusieurs mois et que l’attention des joueurs s’est tournée vers d’autres sujets, comme les mises à jour en ligne ou les éventuels contenus additionnels. La prétendue build de développement serait donc antérieure à la version finale, ce qui soulève immédiatement des questions sur son intérêt réel et sur les motivations de son diffuseur.
Les experts en cybersécurité et les dataminers habitués à ce genre de fuites rappellent que les builds de développement sont des versions internes utilisées par les studios pour tester le jeu en cours de production. Elles contiennent souvent du contenu inachevé, des bugs, des outils de debug et parfois des éléments qui ne sont pas destinés au public. Si une telle build venait à être authentifiée, elle pourrait révéler des détails sur le processus de création du jeu, mais elle n’apporterait probablement rien de nouveau aux joueurs qui ont déjà exploré la version finale.
Le pseudonyme Cyberleek n’est pas inconnu des communautés de joueurs. Par le passé, ce même individu ou groupe a déjà prétendu détenir des informations exclusives sur des jeux très attendus, sans jamais fournir de preuves convaincantes. La plupart de ses annonces se sont soldées par des échecs retentissants, et sa crédibilité est aujourd’hui quasi nulle auprès des observateurs sérieux. Cette nouvelle sortie médiatique est donc perçue comme une énième tentative de se faire remarquer, surfant sur la notoriété de GTA 6 pour attirer l’attention.
Il est important de noter que Rockstar Games, le développeur du jeu, n’a fait aucun commentaire officiel sur cette affaire. La société est connue pour sa discrétion et sa politique stricte en matière de sécurité, et il est peu probable qu’elle réagisse à des allégations non fondées. En l’absence de déclaration officielle ou de preuve matérielle, il convient de traiter cette information avec la plus grande prudence.
Au-delà de la simple désinformation, ce type d’annonce peut avoir des conséquences néfastes pour les joueurs. Certains individus mal intentionnés profitent de l’engouement autour des jeux populaires pour diffuser des logiciels malveillants déguisés en builds ou en outils de piratage. Les joueurs trop crédules qui tenteraient de télécharger ces prétendues versions s’exposent à des risques de vol de données, d’infection de leur système ou d’escroquerie. Il est donc essentiel de ne jamais télécharger de fichiers provenant de sources non officielles et de se méfier des offres trop alléchantes.
Par ailleurs, la diffusion de builds de développement, si elle était avérée, constituerait une violation grave des droits d’auteur et des secrets commerciaux de Rockstar Games. Les précédentes fuites majeures dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo ont donné lieu à des poursuites judiciaires et à des condamnations sévères. Les auteurs de telles infractions encourent des peines de prison et des amendes considérables, ce qui n’a pas empêché certains de récidiver.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, les réactions à l’annonce de Cyberleek oscillent entre amusement et agacement. De nombreux joueurs rappellent les précédentes frasques de ce personnage et invitent à ne pas lui accorder de crédit. D’autres soulignent que même si une build de développement existait, elle n’aurait que peu d’intérêt à ce stade, le jeu étant déjà sorti et largement analysé. Certains évoquent la possibilité d’un canular destiné à tester la réactivité des médias et des communautés.
En attendant d’éventuelles preuves concrètes, il est recommandé de considérer cette information comme une rumeur non fondée. Les joueurs désireux d’en savoir plus sur GTA 6 peuvent se tourner vers les sources officielles de Rockstar Games ou vers des médias reconnus

Hacker group Cyberleek has returned for the first time since Grand Theft Auto 6’s launch and is claiming to have released a development build of the game on their site.
The site’s latest update shows a link titled: “ XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026)”.
Screenshots being shared on social media appear to show that the files are from a development build of GTA 6’s Xbox release. The executable file is missing, preventing people with access from playing the build themselves.
In a statement, Cyberleek threatened to release the executable at a later date.
“It is done,” the statement reads. “CL [Cyberleek] holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI, and it is going out by torrent. Now. Every file except one — the main executable — held on a countdown.
“It is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons.
“If the Xbox build cannot be made to work and support holds, CL will work to get a PS5 build — a fallback, most likely never required. Either way: the Xbox build is going out. No double dipping for Take-Two / Rockstar .”
Cyberleek goes on to say that the release of the executable file is on a timer. However, they also say they will release it earlier if their crypto token reaches a certain market value.
This comes as part of Cyberleek’s ongoing campaign against Rockstar , which they claim is in aid of consumer rights. They say they take particular issue with GTA 6 being a digital-only release.
The group has been posting authentic gameplay clips from Grand Theft Auto 6 for months, even ahead of Rockstar’s own official Netflix reveal .
However, Cyberleek has also enriched themselves greatly throughout this process. They have always encouraged crypto donations, and even made them mandatory if fans wanted to participate in polls to decide what was leaked next.
Take-Two previously indicated that its efforts to track down the leaker were “rapidly evolving”. The Rockstar parent company has filed multiple subpoenas to Discord, demanding information on specific servers and users.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 est sorti sur consoles le 19 novembre 2026. Sur PC, on attend toujours que Rockstar annonce quelque chose. Le site officiel du jeu présente les versions PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, sans date pour...
articles.txt:
GTA 6 est sorti sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Sur PC, Rockstar n’a donné ni date ni configuration. Il faut dire que sur GTA V , les joueurs PC avaient attendu dix-neuf mois. GTA 6 est sorti sur consoles le 19 novembre 2026. Sur PC, on attend toujours que Rockstar annonce quelque chose. Le site officiel du jeu présente les versions PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, sans date pour une version ordinateur.
Si c’est ce jeu qui doit vous décider à changer de carte graphique, autant attendre de savoir ce qu’il demandera. Pour le moment, on n’a ni année de sortie ni configuration PC.
Rockstar avait sorti GTA V sur consoles le 17 septembre 2013 . La version PC était arrivée le 14 avril 2015 , près de dix-neuf mois plus tard. Le souvenir de cette attente explique une bonne partie des discussions autour de GTA 6 .
Ça donne une idée de la façon dont Rockstar Games a déjà échelonné une sortie. Les délais de développement et le calendrier commercial peuvent changer d’un épisode à l’autre. Il serait bien commode d’ajouter dix-neuf mois à la sortie sur consoles. Il faudrait encore savoir si Rockstar fait le même calcul.
Sans annonce PC, il n’y a pas non plus de configuration minimale ou recommandée officielle à comparer à sa machine. Si un tableau vous donne déjà un processeur, une carte graphique et la place à faire sur le SSD, regardez d’abord s’il renvoie à une annonce de Rockstar. La puissance nécessaire sur console ne suffit pas à établir une liste de composants PC.
Même prudence pour le prix et les boutiques. Les éditions Standard et Ultime de GTA 6 vendues sur consoles ne constituent pas l’annonce d’une édition PC au même tarif.
L’ accès à GTA 6 par Xbox Cloud Gaming annoncé pour le lancement concerne les consoles Xbox One et Xbox Series X|S. Il ne faut pas en déduire que le jeu est disponible dans un navigateur sur ordinateur.
Rockstar aurait tout de même intérêt à ne pas trop traîner pour la version PC. Avec l’aide des outils d’IA, des pirates pourraient finir par le devancer et proposer leur propre portage. Une partie des joueurs pourrait alors récupérer le jeu gratuitement sans acheter ensuite la version officielle. Pour un titre aussi attendu, le manque à gagner pourrait être conséquent.
En attendant une annonce PC, les versions disponibles restent celles des consoles. Notre page principale sur GTA 6 rassemble les plateformes et les informations sur la sortie.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Standard ou Ultime, quelle édition choisir ?
articles.chapeau: 79,99 € pour le jeu, 99,99 € pour le jeu avec des suppléments. Les tarifs de GTA 6 sont les mêmes sur le PlayStation Store français et sur la boutique Xbox française . Ce sont les prix des...
articles.txt:
GTA 6 coûte 79,99 € en Standard et 99,99 € en Ultime sur les boutiques françaises de PlayStation et Xbox. Reste à voir ce que les vingt euros de plus apportent, et ce que contient vraiment la boîte PS5. 79,99 € pour le jeu, 99,99 € pour le jeu avec des suppléments. Les tarifs de GTA 6 sont les mêmes sur le PlayStation Store français et sur la boutique Xbox française . Ce sont les prix des versions numériques, qui ne disent évidemment rien des remises proposées chez les revendeurs.
Les deux éditions donnent accès à l’aventure de Jason et Lucia. Le choix se fait donc sur les ajouts de l’Ultime, pas sur la possibilité de terminer l’histoire avec la Standard.
L’Ultime ajoute des véhicules, des armes et des possibilités de personnalisation, mais aussi des activités et des lieux particuliers. Ce serait donc aller un peu vite que de la réduire à quelques vêtements. Parmi les exemples présentés figurent la Grotti Cheetah de 1995 et les revolvers Morgan de Hawk & Little. Les bonus se débloquent au fil de l’histoire : acheter cette édition ne signifie pas retrouver immédiatement tout son contenu dans le garage.
Pour choisir, autant regarder les ajouts qui vous intéressent réellement. Si vous voulez surtout suivre l’histoire et découvrir le Leonida, la Standard contient déjà le jeu. Si les véhicules et activités supplémentaires vous attirent, la présentation de l’Ultime permet de vérifier ce que vous achetez. Notre revue de presse des tests de GTA 6 porte, elle, sur l’accueil du jeu, pas sur la valeur de ces seuls bonus.
Oui. Sur Xbox, la mise à niveau est vendue 20 € et nécessite de posséder le jeu de base. Sur PS5, Sony indique que le passage à l’Ultime se fait sur le PlayStation Store, y compris si l’on a acheté la Standard en boîte. Il faut bien choisir le supplément correspondant à sa plateforme.
Voilà un détail à connaître avant de passer en caisse. D’après l’ assistance PlayStation , l’édition Standard physique PS5 contient un code de téléchargement, sans disque. Acheter la boîte ne dispense donc pas de télécharger le jeu. Notre guide d’installation de GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox reprend les étapes et les vérifications utiles avant de lancer le transfert.
Ces prix concernent les consoles. Pour un achat sur ordinateur, mieux vaut commencer par la situation de la version PC de GTA 6 . Les plateformes et les autres informations pratiques sont rassemblées dans notre dossier principal sur GTA 6 . Sur Xbox One, il faut aussi compter avec les conditions d’accès au cloud .

articles.txt:
Il n’y a pas de carte de Leonida dans la boîte de GTA 6, sorti ce jeudi 19 novembre en France sur PS5 et Xbox Series . Rockstar a toutefois publié gratuitement le fichier de la carte de Leonida sur le site officiel du jeu. Vous pouvez tenter d’utiliser votre super imprimante pour obtenir une version papier de cette carte.
Rockstar propose également une version « Printable » (imprimable), beaucoup plus lourde (44,4 Mo), il faut passer par ce lien . La définition est alors de 5 775 x 7 900 pixels : parfait pour une impression en haute qualité.
Le fichier web est un JPEG de 2 805 × 3 840 pixels (environ 2,2 Mo), au format portrait. On y découvre l’intégralité de Leonida, la Floride version Rockstar , découpée en cinq comtés : Lummox County au nord, Kelly County à l’ouest, Leonard County au nord-est, Vice-Dale County autour de Vice City, et Mariana County au sud.

articles.txt:
Rockstar Games a caché la Mitsubishi Eclipse de Paul Walker dans Fast and Furious à l’intérieur d’un garage de Vice City sur GTA 6.
Impossible de concevoir un jeu centré sur les braquages et les courses-poursuites sans rendre hommage au cinéma automobile. À peine Grand Theft Auto VI sorti, les joueurs ont débusqué un clin d’œil appuyé à la saga Fast and Furious et au regretté Paul Walker , disparu en 2013. Il est en effet possible de prendre le volant d’une réplique de la célèbre Mitsubishi Eclipse verte conduite par son personnage, Brian O’Connor, dans le tout premier volet de la franchise en 2001.
Contrairement à d’autres secrets qui demandent des heures d’exploration, ce bolide est accessible dès le début de l’aventure , sitôt les premières séquences d’introduction terminées. Il suffit d’entreprendre le trajet jusqu’à Vespucci Island , dans Vice City, et de repérer une villa abritant un garage fermé .
Une fois à l’intérieur de la propriété, il faut forcer une porte menant au garage pour découvrir la sportive garée à l’abri des regards. La méthode d’appropriation reste fidèle aux habitudes de la franchise : briser la vitre latérale et faire les fils à l’aide des joysticks de la manette. Beaucoup plus rapide que le véhicule de départ de Jason, cette monture permet d’arpenter l’asphalte floridien à vive allure dès les premières heures de jeu.
Les développeurs ont d’ailleurs glissé une seconde surprise dans ce même garage. En fracturant le coffre de la Mitsubishi Eclipse, le joueur se fait attaquer par un grand serpent caché à l’intérieur. Un jeu de mots visuel pensé pour les anglophones qui renvoie directement à la réplique culte du shérif Woody dans Toy Story (« There’s a snake in my boot « , le terme boot désignant aussi bien une botte que le coffre d’une voiture au Royaume-Uni).
Cette trouvaille automobile s’inscrit dans une chasse aux secrets déjà très prolifique à travers l’État de Leonida. En plus des références sérielles comme l’ appartement de Dexter Morgan à Washington Island – auquel nous avons consacré un article dédié -, les curieux ont mis au jour une foule de clins d’œil. Entre un chien à lunettes de soleil pilotant un jet-ski près de Gambit Bay , ou encore de véritables œufs de Pâques perchés au sommet d’une tour de télécommunication , Rockstar Games prouve une nouvelle fois son goût pour les détails dissimulés.
De quoi occuper les joueurs pendant des centaines d’heures en marge de la trame principale.
Votre soutien est important pour Eklecty-City, retrouvez toutes les actualités pop culture sur les réseaux sociaux : Facebook , BlueSky , Instagram , Twitter .

articles.chapeau: Lorsque vous démarrerez votre partie dans Grand Theft Auto VI, Jason n’aura accès qu’à des fonds limités et ne pourra donc pas se [...]
articles.txt:
Lorsque vous démarrerez votre partie dans Grand Theft Auto VI , Jason n’aura accès qu’à des fonds limités et ne pourra donc pas se balader avec un arsenal complet sur lui, étant donné que les armes demandent une certaine somme. Heureusement, vous pouvez aussi en voler. Surtout dans une maison du sud-est de Key Lento, accessible dès le début du jeu, où vous attendent un fusil à pompe, des munitions et votre premier sniper : le Fusil de précision SMS-01 , l’une des armes uniques de GTA 6 .
Où trouver des armes et un sniper dès le début de GTA 6 ? Pas besoin d’aller très loin dans GTA 6 pour équiper Jason comme une machine de guerre. Et pas besoin d’aller à l’armurerie non plus. Ce qu’on vous propose ici, c’est un moyen simple, rapide, et presque sans danger pour avoir accès à tout un tas d’armes de poing et d’épaule très facilement à quelques mètres de la maison de notre héros.
Pour cela, rendez-vous au sud-est de la région de Key Lento, à l’endroit indiqué sur la map ci-dessus (là où vous voyez l’icône Munitions). Vous trouverez ici une simple maison qui n’a rien de particulier au premier abord.
En montant jusque devant la porte d’entrée, vous verrez un panneau « Attention au chien dangereux », mais pas de panique, ce n’est qu’un leurre. Enfoncez la porte pour vous retrouver nez-à-nez devant un vieil homme, qui est une caricature parfaite de l’Américain adorateur d’armes à feu. Il va vous tirer dessus, mais deux coups de poing suffiront à l’endormir.
Une fois cela effectué, dépêchez-vous de faire le tour des lieux avant que la police n’arrive. Vous trouverez un coffre-fort avec un peu d’argent, mais surtout beaucoup d’armes et de munitions, que ce soit un fusil à pompe ou d’autres joyeusetés. Mieux encore, le Fusil de précision SMS-01 vous attend sagement . Il s’agit là de l’une des armes uniques du jeu, alors prenez-en bien soin.
Avec le Fusil de précision SMS-01 et le stock d’armes de cette maison de Key Lento, Jason va démarrer GTA 6 bien équipé. Pour garder les armes lourdes sous la main, pensez au coffre de vos véhicules personnels, détaillé (on vous en parle dans nos 15 conseils pour bien débuter dans GTA 6 ), et retrouvez toutes les autres astuces dans notre guide complet de GTA 6 .

articles.t: GTA 6 nommé aux Game Awards 2026 avant même sa sortie, comment c’est possible ?
articles.chapeau: Huit nominations, dont celle de jeu de l’année, pour un jeu que personne ne pouvait encore acheter. Ça surprend, mais l’explication est plutôt simple.
articles.txt:
Huit nominations, dont celle de jeu de l’année, pour un jeu que personne ne pouvait encore acheter. Ça surprend, mais l’explication est plutôt simple.
Geoff Keighley a dévoilé la liste des nommés des Game Awards 2026 . Sans grande surprise, GTA 6 arrive en tête, puisque le jeu de Rockstar décroche huit nominations , plus que n’importe quel autre titre cette année. Par contre, ça fait tiquer pas mal de monde : GTA 6 ne sort qu’aujourd’hui, le 19 novembre, sur PS5 et Xbox Series . Beaucoup se demandent donc comment il peut prétendre au titre de jeu de l’année . On vous raconte tout.
Comme chaque année, la cérémonie fixe une date limite d’éligibilité. Pour 2026, la FAQ officielle est claire : les jeux doivent être commercialisés au plus tard le vendredi 20 novembre 2026 à 21 h, heure du Pacifique, donc samedi 21 novembre à 6 h chez nous . GTA 6 sort le 19, il est donc dans les clous. Le vote du public (Players’ Voice) a sa propre date limite, fixée au 30 novembre.
Forcément, certains ont trouvé que cette date tombait un peu trop bien, au point de la juger taillée sur mesure pour Rockstar. Geoff Keighley s’en est défendu en expliquant que les dates sont fixées de la même manière chaque année, et que les éditeurs tiennent sans doute compte du calendrier de la cérémonie au moment de caler leurs sorties . Et effectivement, la date limite tombe comme d’habitude sur le troisième vendredi de novembre. Ce n’est donc pas la cérémonie qui s’est adaptée à Rockstar, c’est plutôt l’inverse.
Être éligible, c’est bien, mais encore faut-il que les votants aient touché au jeu. Les nommés sont choisis par un jury mondial dont le Journal du Geek fait partie avec plus de 160 médias et créateurs de contenu, qui peuvent recevoir un accès anticipé aux jeux pour les évaluer. Les jurés ont donc pu passer du temps sur GTA 6 bien avant sa sortie , d’où l’arrivée de notre test la veille de la date de sortie pour le grand public, après avoir fini l’histoire du jeu.
Au fond, c’est le même principe que pour n’importe quel jeu sorti fin novembre. C’est juste que d’habitude, personne ne s’en rend compte.
GTA 6 est nommé dans les catégories jeu de l’année, meilleure direction, meilleure narration, meilleure direction artistique, meilleur jeu d’action/aventure, meilleur design sonore, meilleure bande-son, et meilleure performance pour Manni L. Perez qui joue Lucia . Pour le titre suprême, il affronte 007 First Light , Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem et The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time . Si vous voulez donner votre avis, le vote du public est ouvert sur le site officiel des Game Awards.
Verdict le 10 décembre, en direct du Peacock Theater de Los Angeles, donc dans la nuit du 10 au 11 décembre en France .

GTA 6’s Best-Kept Secret Is the Most Important Part of the Game
articles.chapeau: The prologue of GTA 6 starts with a shock
articles.txt:
Considering how much of Grand Theft Auto 6 leaked before its launch, you’d think that Rockstar’s latest wouldn’t have anything left to hide. I mean, we’ve really seen it all. But as players immediately discovered when starting their save file, Rockstar (kind of) managed to keep one secret — and it was a huge one.
[Ed. note: This article contains spoilers for the prologue of GTA 6. ]
GTA 6 kicks off with a short prologue chapter that sets a few things in motion . First, we get to see the moment Jason and Lucia met , as they both got crossed trying to jack the same car. A rom-com montage ensues, but things take a turn fast. We fast-forward to Lucia sitting in a restaurant as she prepares to pull off a robbery across the street. After nervously stalling , she works up the courage to stick the place up. Unfortunately, it doesn’t go well. The cops quickly intervene and arrest her.
The twist comes as she’s being put into the back of a cop car. A panicked Lucia begs the cops to take her back to the restaurant where she was holed up before the robbery, because she left something there. The cops discover something that the camera was carefully hiding earlier in the sequence: Lucia’s infant son, Tommy, who she left unattended.
As we soon learn, Tommy is Jason and Lucia’s son. Tommy now lives with a separate guardian after getting taken from Lucia’s custody; Jason and Lucia only get to see him through occasional photos that get texted to them. It turns out that Jason and Lucia’s whole motivation for making cash in GTA 6 is to fund a family savings account in hopes that they can reunite with their son and give him a normal life.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon It’s a shocking revelation that Rockstar desperately wanted to keep hidden as long as possible. No pre-release trailers for the game so much as teased that there was a kid in the picture. When I spoke to Rockstar North co-head Rob Nelson just ahead of the game’s launch, he seemed relieved that the detail had mostly gone unspoiled, despite a cavalcade of leaks. (It actually did leak about a year ago, but it faded into a forgotten rumor in a sea of them by the time GTA 6 actually launched.) For Nelson, that initial shock is an important part of an experience that’s designed to challenge what you think you know about its antiheroes at every turn.
With Tommy comes a mess of complicated character dynamics and anxieties that you’ll see throughout GTA 6 ’s story. While Lucia seems like an impulsive loudmouth who doesn’t have a care in the world, it becomes increasingly clear that she’s harboring serious insecurity after having Tommy taken from her. She quietly worries that she doesn’t deserve to be a parent after leaving her kid to go pull off a stick-up. While Jason wasn’t part of that, he holds the same fear that someone like him isn’t responsible enough to be a father. Those feelings bleed out whenever the two receive a text with a photo of Tommy and are reminded of the kid who is growing up somewhere without them.
Tommy also adds some welcome tension into Jason and Lucia’s love story, considering that the romance can be largely free of friction otherwise (depending on how you engage with the romance system). At one point, the two broke into a spontaneous conversation about their family. Jason noted that Lucia’s mother doesn’t seem to like him very much, which prompted Lucia to reveal that she lied to her mom and told her that Jason didn’t want to be involved in Tommy’s life. Though that isn’t exactly true given that Jason didn’t know his son existed, Lucia then recalled a conversation where Jason told her he didn’t want to have kids. That exchange gives us context that explains why Lucia didn’t tell Jason about Tommy upfront. For Nelson, those little details help build a nuanced story of two reluctant parents trying to figure out how to adapt to an unexpected responsibility.

It’s sympathetic to Lucia’s circumstances, making a point in a flashback to show her struggling to live as a single mother in a world that is hostile to her specific needs.
